name: Go
description: Installs the Go toolchain with go and gofmt on a selectable channel or release line.

version.description: Channel (latest), a minor line (major.minor), or an exact version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: If set, puts this feature's data at this path, which must be inside the remote user's home. Mount a volume there to persist it across rebuilds.

env.name: GOTOOLCHAIN
env.description: Go runs the installed toolchain, and others on explicit request

env.name: GOPATH
env.description: Modules and installed tools in the state dir

env.name: GOCACHE
env.description: Go's build cache in the state dir
